description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. Runs a shell command (`/bin/bash -l -c`) in a running sandbox and answers when it exits: stdout, stderr, exit_code (null when killed by the timeout), timed_out. timeout_s defaults to 50, so the answer comes back inside common client tool timeouts. For work that runs longer (servers, builds, training), start it with rent_start_process and read its output with rent_get_process_output. Arguments not listed here go to the REST route as they are, which refuses them by name.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id (`lse_…`) from rent_create_sandbox or rent_list_sandboxes. It names the sandbox for its whole life and keeps answering rent_get_sandbox, with the final state, after it ends.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the command is killed. Default 50.

name: rent_exec
title: Run a command
